## File: huggingface_data-is-better-together/community-efforts/prompt_translation/dashboard_template/app.py

Prompts

```
['run the gradio dashboard app for the multilingual prompt translation project', 'fetch source and target datasets from argilla filtered by pending and submitted status', 'get a dictionary mapping usernames to their annotation counts from an argilla dataset', 'create an altair donut chart showing annotated versus pending records progress', 'get a dataframe of the top N contributors sorted by number of annotations']
```

Usage

```
{'run_dashboard_app': 'run the gradio dashboard app for the multilingual prompt translation project', 'fetch_argilla_datasets': 'fetch source and target datasets from argilla filtered by pending and submitted status', 'get_user_annotations': 'get a dictionary mapping usernames to their annotation counts from an argilla dataset', 'create_donut_chart': 'create an altair donut chart showing annotated versus pending records progress', 'get_top_contributors': 'get a dataframe of the top N contributors sorted by number of annotations'}
```
